method: Unchanged actual original PlayerSystem, DropSystem, ParachuteSystem and Collision2DSystem with original Elf/Drop/Parachute/Arrival/THREE, canonical ?module imports. Before/after snapshots surround the source collision -> drop -> parachute -> player stages. Explicit spawn tiles, irregular wall times, held ticks and a long frame isolate queue/carry/landing/reparent/registration order. Map states held at 1; LOD/input/state counters are no-ops; one actual Bot.update landing-target case has explicit last target/path and fixed .8 throw selection; its queued target retains the actor position reference through PlayerSystem reparenting. No BotSystem population/random lifecycle, model loading, effects, client HUD, erosion, audio or restart is certified. Drop random scale is measured and imported by native tests; does not certify random consumption. Actual source rendering precedes system updates, so before state determines what can render.
